note: ADR-0500 withdraws URL support in --database, so accept the remote bundle URL through --load instead and make a URL in --database a usage error (exit 2) naming `--load <url>`, reusing ADR-0496's GitHub rewrite, https-only and .cl policy, and capped streaming stage, with the scratch copy treated as a released ephemeral store.

Treat `query` as a first-positional statement-session verb in every bundle with [STATEMENT] and -d/--database PATH (default :memory:), no combining with -c, a shared help options block, and the command did-you-mean on usage errors.

Add the procedure with no database argument (ADR-0227 signatures), put it behind the `ontology` preview gate alongside the other four, follow the transaction rules, list it in SHOW PROCEDURES, and build it always in cypherlite-ontology.

Extend the frontier kernel's re-arrival trail-existence rule for an already-visited (node,state) pair, bound its work with a budget that falls through to the DFS, and keep accept-on-arrival before dedup, the answer-shape gate, and the generalized compile unchanged.

Add once-only post-verb --read-only/--follow to `serve`, open ReadOnly/Follow with one shared handle across all surfaces, reject pre-verb use, pass the flags through the Docker entrypoint, and do the MCP part through `serve --mcp` because ADR-0368 retired the standalone cypherlite-mcp bin that ADR-0306 clause 8 targeted.

Implement `snapshot DATABASE --to/--from FILE.cl` as an exit-after first-positional verb that opens the source read-only, requires a non-existent destination and cleans up on failure, keeps the source codec, and goes through snapshot_to_bundle/restore_from_bundle with no new Cargo feature.
